Anya C.: Heads-up — opened a docs PR that bundles updated SDK snippets for streaming + retries + pagination across Py/TS/Go. Need a quick pass for correctness and tiny lint fixes before I merge: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123
Jordan H.: Thanks — will do. Quick checklist?
Anya C.: 1) Python: show async iterator + backoff example; 2) TS: show streaming resume token + short example for function calling; 3) Go: include context cancellation and small retry wrapper; 4) add a note about token accounting with streaming.
Sam W.: I can sanity-check the TS and the resume behavior. Do we want to keep the minimal SDK usage (no helpers) or show the helper wrapper in the snippet?
Anya C.: Keep minimal inline usage but add a short "helper" appendix for teams that want to productionize it.
Mike P.: For Go I'll add the ctx cancel example — will also include a short snippet that uses exponential backoff jitter for retries. Example I'll add:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
defer cancel()
resp, err := client.Stream(ctx, req)
if err != nil { return err }
for {
    chunk, ok := resp.Recv()
    if !ok { break }
    // handle chunk
}
```
Lucy Z.: FYI the linter (prettier + black) will reformat some of the inline JS/Py examples. I can run the formatting in a follow-up commit.
Jordan H.: Sam — can you also verify that the TS streaming sample shows how to resume using the cursor token? We had one bug where the SDK returned a base64 token that needed decode.
Sam W.: Yep — I'll test locally. Will try both node and deno flows.
Anya C.: docs-bot: can you post the deploy preview once CI finishes so we can eyeball the rendered code blocks?
docs-bot: Deploy preview for PR #4123 is available: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/4123 — build passed (lint: warn, tests: ok).
Mike P.: One small semantics question — the Python example uses a small backoff of 100ms initial. Should we recommend larger defaults for prod?
Anya C.: Good call — add a short aside: "Defaults shown for readability; increase backoff and cap before production."
Sam W.: Tested TS resume token flow — small note: we need to call `Buffer.from(token, 'base64').toString()` in the example to be explicit. I pushed a fix to the branch.
Jordan H.: I found one doc link that pointed to the old pagination page. Fixed in the draft.
Lucy Z.: Ran formatters and pushed. There were 2-3 trailing whitespace issues in the Go snippet.
Anya C.: Awesome — can folks +1 merging after CI? Would like to land by EOD.
Sam W.: +1 (checked the TS behavior)
Jordan H.: +1 (doc links + examples look good)
Mike P.: +1 (Go sample tested)
Lucy Z.: +1 (formatting done)
docs-bot: PR #4123 merged by Anya C. — deploy queued. :tada:
